kind: Pure deterministic reference/period/denominator guards using frozen canonical selectors; not an NLP backend or native interaction test

checks.name: General assortment question keeps the frozen population without a fabricated identity
Generic metric and store-level wording do not fabricate a SKU/store reference
One canonical SKU mention resolves to a named answer cohort
One canonical store mention resolves to the exact store
Unknown SKU asks for a permitted concrete identity before any broad answer
Unknown store never silently becomes all stores
Multiple explicit SKU IDs require one identity or an explicitly confirmed named cohort
Confirmed SKU choice retains the original unknown question but narrows only its answer
A known SKU outside the frozen global scope is not retrieved through clarification
Same-named products are never merged by name
Multiple stores require an explicit answer selection
Vague last-month period presents exact dates inside frozen evidence
Confirmed period narrows reply evidence without rewriting global filters
Named different period and future date cannot silently broaden the frozen interval
Unspecified denominator asks which distinct definition applies
A confirmed ranged-pair denominator uses its actual frozen exposure, not the S15 sample
Explicit PWPS example retains source-cell aliases and inference bounds
Restricted gross margin cannot be selected as a clarification escape hatch
No-comparator question offers explicit supported comparisons
Diagonal pair cohorts constrain store choices after a SKU is confirmed
